Players will sign up with their opponent, select a game, select maps, and then play a single {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} during the show. It is a multi-game show, featuring games like Doom 2, '''Quakeworld''', Quake II, Quake Live, Quake 4, CPMA, Diabotical, Doombringer, Warfork, Quake Champions, and more! Organ Grinder's sister show, [[Organ Harvester]], will review, preview and interview one day ahead of the main event,
